intro: Prepare a render once, then explore its zoom or use it in a video. The settings in section 1 serve both kinds of render: baked (frozen colors) or recolorable (pre-color data).
savedHint: {count} items saved. Resuming keeps the saved doublings. The file is finalized on stop. Keep this panel open during the computation.
timings: Compute {compute} s · WebP {encode} s · Write {write} s · Save wait {wait} s. These durations overlap.

errors.resumeToComplete: Resume the preparation to complete this document.

common.title: 1 · Common settings
common.name: Name
common.planProblem: Check the coordinates and scales: the start must be wider than the end.

baked.title: 2 · Baked render (.expmap)
baked.hint: Current colors and materials frozen into one WebP image per doubling. Explorable and usable in a video without recomputation.
baked.pathHint: Colors and materials baked by depth. The path and the identity of its images are kept for resuming.
baked.webpHint: Lossy WebP · 0.90 recommended. Fine details and seams may vary with compression.
baked.memoryDetail: 14 tiles in GPU memory · {decode} MiB per decoded tile. Two compute buffers: {buffers} MiB, excluding codec surfaces. Full cache: {raw} GiB before compression.
baked.forceHint: Bakes the effects as they are. Seams or differences after resuming may appear.
baked.parallelHint: Computation and saving progress in parallel. The player keeps 14 tiles and prefetches the next one. The computation includes 12 extra doublings to cover the center, without a mask.

library.title: 4 · Saved baked renders
library.empty: No saved render. Create your first ExpMap above or open its .expmap file.

imageExport.title: Full image · {name}
imageExport.hint: Horizontal angle, vertical depth, without the technical margins. Includes the center coverage doublings. Up to 32 megapixels.
